configuration.B2_convention: literal scalar mode-summed opacity in the fixed-omega Eq. (B.2) ray exponent

charge_cases.both_charges: mu-minus plus mu-plus exact moving-muon Compton rates

inactive_region_omission_diagnostic.interpretation: At inactive radial nodes the B.16 Compton term is retained. The omitted B.13 replacement is restricted to nodes whose maximum local Compton fraction is below the declared threshold; the associated B.1 source and B.2 path weights are reported.

local_rate_grid_summary.note: The full JSON retains all radial-energy local rate arrays. This compact summary intentionally omits those arrays but records the exact source-file hash and grid metadata.

profile.identity: 1687-row vertex-preserving reconstruction from public figures; not raw Garching simulation output

scope: B.13 exact Compton production and reduced absorption are replaced together in the consistent variants.
B.13 mu-minus-only and mu-minus-plus-mu-plus cases are reported separately.
The B.16 neutrino inverse-decay and dimuon channels are unchanged.
The literal scalar mode-summed fixed-omega B.2 prescription is retained to isolate the Compton-kernel change.
No empirical source, opacity, coupling, or luminosity rescaling is applied.
No production axial-vector curve, manuscript, or referee-response file is modified.
title: Global B.13 exact moving-muon Compton replacement in the 10 MeV vector B.1/B.2 benchmark
